tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 57 (vocabulary round 4 - consolidated coverage-sweep gaps). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - a 51-phrase live coverage sweep of patient date/time verbiage found six families that fall through to from_unresolved (a safe ask-for-a-date, but a wasted patient turn). Design rule: the patient's verbatim is the authority; deterministic resolution lives in the gateway. All six families are pure date/time interpretation - no behavior outside them may change.

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW56/gw-daypart-authority/fixed-bland_gateway.py (byte-identical to the deployed lane-56 gateway: lanes 51-56 all present) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW56/gw-daypart-authority/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

THE SIX FAMILIES (resolve at the same handler-level seams the existing vocabulary uses):
F1 STANDALONE WEEK-AFTER-NEXT: 'week after next' (also 'the week after next') -> the Monday-Sunday week containing today+14; window = that full week clipped to today. Reuse the existing week-window mechanism.
F2 ANAPHORIC WEEK FORMS (require parseable context_date, same guard style as resolve_anaphoric_week): 'the following week' / 'the week after' -> the week AFTER the week containing context_date. 'same day next week' -> context_date's weekday, 7 days after context_date (single day). No context -> unchanged fall-through.
F3 MONTH-PART WINDOWS: 'end of the month' -> [25th..last day] of the CURRENT month, clipped to today (if today is past the 25th, start at today; if today is past month-end… impossible, ignore); 'beginning of next month' / 'early next month' -> [1st..7th] of next month; 'middle of next month' / 'mid next month' -> [10th..20th] of next month; 'middle of the month'/'mid-month' -> [10th..20th] of the current month clipped to today, rolling to next month if the 20th has passed. Reuse the existing end-of-month window mechanism (lane 51/53 already handle 'end of next month' and 'tail end' forms - keep them byte-identical).
F4 DAY-PART IDIOMS (extend the lane-56 day-part table, same trigger guards - no explicit after/before, no anchor, 'good <x>' greeting excluded): 'after lunch' -> after 1:00 pm; 'lunchtime'/'around lunch' -> 11:00 am - 2:00 pm window; 'after work' -> after 4:00 pm; 'first thing' -> before 12:00 pm AND time_pref earliest-style ordering if the mechanism exists, else just before 12:00 pm.
F5 VERBATIM TIME WINDOWS (apply only when extraction sent after=none AND before=none AND no anchor - the extraction-dropped case): 'between X and Y' -> after X, before Y (bare hours resolved through the existing lane-51 meridiem inference); 'no earlier than X'/'not before X' -> after X; 'before noon'/'by noon' -> before 12:00 pm; 'no later than X'/'by X' -> before X.
F6 SPELLED CLOCK IDIOMS (when time_pref carries no anchor but the verbatim contains one of these, resolve to an anchor through the EXISTING anchor path): 'half past <hour-word-or-digit>' -> H:30; 'quarter past <h>' -> H:15; 'quarter to <h>' -> (H-1):45; hour words one..twelve accepted; meridiem from the existing lane-51 inference unless stated.
PRECEDENCE: explicit extraction values always win (F4/F5/F6 fire only on the dropped case); an anchor outranks a day-part window (existing lane-56 rule, keep); F2 anaphors lose to an explicit ordinal in the verbatim (existing lane-55 rule, keep).

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_vocab4.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam, all dates derived from datetime.date.today(). Compute: wan = Monday of the week containing today+14; ctx = today+21 formatted '%m/%d/%Y 10:30 am'; fw = Monday of the week AFTER ctx's week; sdnw = ctx's date + 7 days; eom_lo = max(today, current month 25th); bnm_lo = 1st of next month. Print exactly:
  CASE=week-after-next FROM=<max(wan, today) iso>
  CASE=following-week FROM=<fw iso> (context=ctx)
  CASE=same-day-next-week FROM=<sdnw iso> (context=ctx)
  CASE=end-of-month FROM=<eom_lo iso>
  CASE=beginning-next-month FROM=<bnm_lo iso>
  CASE=after-lunch AFTER=13:00
  CASE=lunchtime WINDOW=11:00-14:00
  CASE=after-work AFTER=16:00
  CASE=first-thing BEFORE=12:00
  CASE=between-2-and-4 AFTER=14:00 BEFORE=16:00
  CASE=no-earlier-than-3 AFTER=15:00
  CASE=before-noon BEFORE=12:00
  CASE=half-past-four ANCHOR=16:30
  CASE=quarter-to-five ANCHOR=16:45
  CASE=explicit-kept AFTER=15:00 (verbatim='between 2 and 4', after='03:00 pm' - extraction wins, no override)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 12 new tests covering every family plus the precedence guards (explicit-extraction-wins, anchor-outranks-daypart, greeting guard still intact).
- DEBUG-GW57.md - what changed, where, per-family trigger regexes and mappings, known limitations.

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep all lane-51..56 behavior intact (run the inherited tests untouched); keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_vocab4.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; wan=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();c=t+d.timedelta(days=14);m=c-d.timedelta(days=c.weekday());print(max(m,t).isoformat())"); fw=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();c=t+d.timedelta(days=21);m=c-d.timedelta(days=c.weekday());print((m+d.timedelta(days=7)).isoformat())"); sdnw=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print((t+d.timedelta(days=28)).isoformat())"); eom=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print(max(t,t.replace(day=25)).isoformat())"); bnm=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print(((t.replace(day=1)+d.timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=1)).isoformat())"); for c in "CASE=week-after-next FROM=$wan" "CASE=following-week FROM=$fw" "CASE=same-day-next-week FROM=$sdnw" "CASE=end-of-month FROM=$eom" "CASE=beginning-next-month FROM=$bnm" 'CASE=after-lunch AFTER=13:00' 'CASE=lunchtime WINDOW=11:00-14:00' 'CASE=after-work AFTER=16:00' 'CASE=first-thing BEFORE=12:00' 'CASE=between-2-and-4 AFTER=14:00 BEFORE=16:00' 'CASE=no-earlier-than-3 AFTER=15:00' 'CASE=before-noon BEFORE=12:00' 'CASE=half-past-four ANCHOR=16:30' 'CASE=quarter-to-five ANCHOR=16:45' 'CASE=explicit-kept AFTER=15:00'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'resolve_anaphoric_week' fixed-bland_gateway.py && grep -q 'closed_day' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: prior lane behavior lost'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 149 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 149 (137 cumulative + 12 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: vocabulary round 4 proven - $summary"
